dialogue.text: I don't think she goes home ofter.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
She seems to spend day and night either here,<d=0.25/>
or in her office.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
At this point,<d=0.25/> wouldn't put it past her to
consider her office to be her home.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Can't tell how many times I've walked in
only to find her cutting logs at the desk.
dialogue.speaker: April
